record.rationale: Dedicated experimental-animal neural imaging dynamics and behavior decoding across WFCI and fUSI; all main real applications neuroscience. Prediction is not causal neural-mechanism validation.

Dedicated protein sequence/structure and multimer modeling; all main applications biomedical molecular structure. Preserve folding/diversity tradeoffs and absence of new experimental activity validation.

Main medical task-specific questions, per-patient outcomes and cross-hospital or CT-to-MRI generalization are independently evaluated and foregrounded in the conclusion; face segmentation is described as additional versatility. Retention does not rest on dataset counts or clinical outcome requirement. Generic method novelty and face-only data-efficiency ablations are retained as limitations to a medical-exclusive characterization.

record.title: Bootstrapping Informative Graph Augmentation via A Meta Learning Approach
record.reason: Substantial biological and molecular experiments are genuine, including dedicated OGB molecular-property results. Nevertheless, the main comparison, component ablation and sensitivity study deliberately give biological and social tasks co-primary evidential roles in cross-domain representation quality. The actual study does not establish biomedical primacy. This is not exclusion for a generic title/method, an absence of biomedical results, or a requirement for biomedical exclusivity or clinical validation.

record.title: Completeness and Diversity in Depth-First Proof-Number Search with Applications to Retrosynthesis
record.reason: The actual application evaluates chemical-route feasibility, diversity and search completeness, without establishing biomedical or medicinal primacy of the principal study. Both the 40 public synthetic-accessibility benchmark molecules and the 20 Bayer-supplied drug-like molecules have drug-like provenance; no non-drug-versus-drug split is inferred. Provenance alone does not establish biomedical primacy. Computational retrosynthesis can qualify when its actual research is biomedical-primary; clinical or wet-lab validation is not required.
